Application Data.NAME: Gourmet Delights Catering
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Gourmet Delights Catering specializes in providing high-quality catering and food preparation services for a variety of events, including corporate functions, weddings, and private parties. Our operations include a fully equipped kitchen located at our Foodville facility, ensuring compliance with all food safety regulations, and sourcing all ingredients from FDA-compliant suppliers. We offer a diverse menu featuring gourmet dishes, with a focus on seasonal and locally sourced ingredients, while maintaining a commitment to excellent service and customer satisfaction. Our off-premises catering services represent a small portion of our overall sales, allowing us to manage risk effectively while serving our clients with utmost care.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a minor incident occurred during a corporate event where a waiter accidentally spilled a tray of appetizers, resulting in minor injuries to one attendee who slipped. The claim was reported on the same day, and the total amount paid for medical expenses and liability was $2,500. The case was closed satisfactorily with no ongoing investigations or disputes.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade A, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols during events, perimeter fencing around kitchen facility, and alarm systems in place.
